lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By the time the statue was clean, the light had gone the colour of weak tea.

lines.speaker: char_pippa
lines.text: It's evening. You can't say good morning in the evening. That's a rule I just made.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: What do you say in the evening?

lines.speaker: char_pippa
lines.text: Good evening, statue. I tried it. It works exactly the same.

lines.speaker: char_pippa
lines.text: Grandma says it's weeks, not years. She says I'm to count too, and not let her cheat.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: And what number are you on?

lines.speaker: char_pippa
lines.text: Zero. It starts when you go. That's how counting works.

lines.speaker: char_pippa
lines.text: Bye, Freyja. Good evening, statue. Good evening, road.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She walked on. Behind her, somebody was wishing the whole road good evening, one stone at a time.
